channel.title: Willitboard: will your cabin bag fit?
channel.description: Cabin bag limits from each operator's official page, checked by a person.

item.title: British Airways cabin bag size and allowance
item.description: Will your bag fit British Airways' cabin limits? Type its size on Willitboard and see in seconds whether it goes at no extra cost, costs extra or doesn't fit. Taken from British Airways' official page and checked by a person, with the date shown on the page.
